eventMetadata.context_description: Arkansas Razorbacks' dominance as an SEC powerhouse drives the 89.5% implied probability against Hawaii Rainbow Warriors, reflecting a stark talent and depth disparity typical in cross-conference matchups. Arkansas enters with momentum from a solid 2023 campaign (7-6 record, bowl win) and key returners like quarterback KJ Jefferson's successor Jacoby Clifford showing promise in camp, while Hawaii limps off a dismal 4-8 season marred by offensive struggles (21.5 PPG) and defensive lapses. No major injuries reported on official team updates for either side, but Arkansas holds home-field edge at Razorback Stadium, where they've won 8 of 10 recent non-conference tilts. Trader consensus prices in Hawaii's travel fatigue and historical underdog woes against Power 5 foes.
